clauses.quote: If the teacher is found guilty or liable in such proceedings, such finding shall constitute a cause for dismissal from the school system.
Fines, damages, penalties, or forfeitures shall not be paid by the Board.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is the Board.

clauses.quote: Civil liability insurance coverage shall be provided for each teacher.
Costs of this coverage shall be paid by the Board.
Civil liability insurance coverage shall not be deemed to provide payment for fines, penalties, or forfeitures arising out of criminal proceedings.

Whenever a teacher is absent from his or her assignment as a result of personal injury caused by an assault arising out of and in the course of his or her employment, he or she shall be paid his or her full salary for the period of such absence not to exceed 180 contract days
clauses.notes: Conditional clause; implicit management obligation to pay salary during injury.

clauses.quote: such paid absence shall in no event be deducted from any sick or personal leave to which such teacher is entitled.
The Board agrees to reimburse the teacher the market value of any personal property damaged or destroyed as a result of assault suffered in connection with his or her employment.
clauses.notes: 'Agrees to reimburse' functions as a contractual obligation.

clauses.quote: Time for appearance before a judicial body or legal authority lost by a teacher in connection with an assault case in connection with his or her employment as a teacher in the District, shall result in no loss of wages or reduction in accumulated leave.
clauses.subject_text: Time for appearance before a judicial body or legal authority lost by a teacher in connection with an assault case in connection with his or her employment as a teacher in the District

clauses.quote: Teachers will be evaluated under the provisions of the Educator Evaluation Law, Title 53A Chapter 10. Utah Code.
Copies of all formative and summative teacher evaluations will be given to the teacher for his or her personal file.
clauses.subject_text: Copies of all formative and summative teacher evaluations

clauses.quote: The teacher shall have the right to attach or submit an explanation, or other written statement regarding any formative or summative evaluation, for inclusion with it in his or her file.
Summative evaluations, or formative evaluations which could lead to corrective discipline, shall only be conducted by fully licensed administrative personnel.
clauses.subject_text: Summative evaluations, or formative evaluations which could lead to corrective discipline

clauses.quote: Materials from files kept in a school shall be used primarily for the improvement of a teacher's performance.
clauses.subject_text: Materials from files kept in a school
